Privacy

Textbound Adventures is designed without accounts, advertising, or third-party tracking.

The game

Textbound Adventures does not require an account and contains no advertising, analytics, or tracking. Adventure progress, command history, memories, room notes, and saved games are stored locally on the device that owns the game runtime.

Apple Watch companion

The Watch companion receives synchronized snapshots from the paired iPhone so it can show current adventure context and submit supported actions. The iPhone remains the game runtime and save owner; the Watch may keep a local cached snapshot for companion use.

Backups and deletion

Device data may be included in Apple backups according to your device and account settings. Removing the app removes its local data from that device; a backup may retain a copy until Apple removes it under your backup settings and policies.

This website

This is a static website. It has no forms, analytics, tracking pixels, or third-party scripts, and it does not set first-party cookies.

Information you choose to share

If you voluntarily send a support report through an Apple service such as TestFlight, that service may include diagnostic information according to your settings and Apple’s policies. Only share what you are comfortable providing.

Questions

Current support information is kept on the support page. This notice will be updated if the game or website begins handling information differently.
